title: MakeReign Marketplace Section
description: Manifest for a reusable section in the MakeReign marketplace. Every section folder ships one of these.

id.description: Stable, globally unique slug. Lowercase hyphenated. e.g. 'hero-split-bold'.

name.description: Human display name. e.g. 'Hero — Split Bold'.

category.description: Marketplace category. Free-form at submission time — designers ship whatever local category their project uses. A curator assigns a canonical marketplace category as part of the curation flow. Conventional categories include: hero, intro, carousel, testimonials, gallery, features, forms, cta, footer, navigation.

track.description: Optional release track. Defaults to 'stable'. Quality band — orthogonal to lifecycle.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle position. `mr submit` sets this to 'Submitted'; a curator merging the PR promotes to 'Approved' (then 'Promoted'); deprecation / archival are explicit curator actions. Optional for backward compatibility; sections without a lifecycle are treated as 'Promoted' (the legacy default).

attribution.description: Authorship + provenance trail. Populated by `mr submit` at submission time; `promotedAt` set by curator on promotion.

originalCreator.description: Handle of the designer who first built this section.

originatingProject.description: Slug of the project where the section was first built.

promotedAt.description: ISO date when the curator promoted the section into the catalogue.

description.description: One-paragraph human + AI summary. What the section is, when to use it, what it expects.

props.description: JSON Schema fragment describing the component's props. Freeform; validated only as 'is an object'.

dependencies.description: Required packages (e.g. 'gsap') or starter-pack components (e.g. '@/components/Section') the section relies on.

motionDensity.description: Motion-density tiers this section supports. Mirrors GLOSSARY.md.

profile.description: Short label for the responsive behaviour. e.g. 'desktop-cinematic / mobile-stacked'.

breakpoints.description: Breakpoint labels the section is tested against. e.g. ['mobile', 'tablet', 'desktop'].

static.description: Path (relative to the section folder) to the static preview image. SVG is permitted for procedurally-generated placeholders; PNG/JPG/WebP for captured screenshots.

live.description: Whether the section supports live iframe preview against a project's design system.

tags.description: Marketplace metadata vocabulary — creative style, industry, storytelling role, emotional tone, etc.

created.description: ISO date when the section was first submitted.

updated.description: ISO date of the most recent change.

curation.description: Curator-authored AI-legibility metadata. Populated during the review/enrichment pass. Describes the layout (structure, slots, page-fit, tonal affordances) — never the brand. An AI given a project brief uses these signals to pick or reject a section, then adapts it to the project's tokens at install time.

intent.description: Single-line structural intent — what the section IS, beyond `category`. e.g. 'Statement-piece hero with split layout — large headline left, structural image right.'

structuralPattern.description: Short layout shape descriptor. e.g. 'split-2col: text-left, image-right', '3-up card grid with header', 'centered-hero + tab-nav'.

structuralSlots.description: Named content slots the layout exposes. e.g. ['eyebrow','h1','subtitle','cta-primary','image-hero','tab-nav','card-grid','quote-pull'].

pageTypes.description: Page types where the layout fits naturally. e.g. ['landing','about','services','contact','case-study','products','blog-listing','blog-post'].

tonalAffordances.description: Tones the layout CAN credibly carry (plural by definition). e.g. ['editorial','premium','minimal','warm']. Not 'is' — 'can'. A layout that only carries one tone is over-specified.

imageryDependence.description: How much the layout relies on imagery to work.

copyDensity.description: Copy length the layout is built for.

composition.description: Page-assembly hints. Section IDs or category names.

antiPairs.description: Sections / categories NOT to put adjacent. e.g. two heroes in a row.
